summary: Mint Inc Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the entry into a joint venture agreement with YAS Digital Group Ltd to form YAS Robotics Limited, a Hong Kong company focused on robotics and AI insurance products. The joint venture is owned 75% by YAS and 25% by Mint, with Mint contributing $1,000,000. The board will have three directors, two from YAS and one from Mint; YAS handles daily management. This is a strategic partnership, not an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. Watch for operational progress and regulatory developments in the InsurTech space.
